	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CHL

		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_signed
		USA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_signed clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_pending }

COLDWAR_CHL_dip_execute_japan_copper = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CHL
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_paid }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting
			COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_clear = yes
			country_exists = JAP
			JAP = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending }
			COLDWAR_CHL_can_build_949_infrastructure_1 = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.47638 }
		divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_chl_0p15_tt
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		JAP = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.01326 }
			divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_jap_0p1_tt
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		949 = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_signed
		JAP = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_signed clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_paid
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting
		COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.100 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_offer_japan_copper = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_offer_japan_copper = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_receipt
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_receipt
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending value = 1 days = 90 }
		JAP = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending value = 1 days = 90 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.3 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_dip_accept_japan_copper = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = JAP
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
			CHL = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting
				COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_clear = yes
				COLDWAR_CHL_can_build_949_infrastructure_1 = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_paid }
			}
		}
		CHL = { COLDWAR_CHL_dip_execute_japan_copper = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				CHL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_signed }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_dip_refuse_japan_copper = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = JAP
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
			CHL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting }
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
		CHL = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.101 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_japan_copper = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_signed
			JAP = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_signed }
			COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_clear = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_chl }
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_chl
		}
		JAP = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_jap }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_jap
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 0.34478 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 0.01321 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_chl
		JAP = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_jap }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHL_offer_argentina_beagle = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_offer_argentina_beagle = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_receipt
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_receipt
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_awaiting

			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_pending value = 1 days = 90 }

			CHL = {

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_awaiting
				COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_clear = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_paid }
			}

COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_argentina_beagle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_signed
			ARG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_signed }
			COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_clear = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_chl }
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_chl
		}
		ARG = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_arg }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_arg
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 2.42118 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 8.25729 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_chl
		ARG = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_arg }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHL_dip_execute_peru_maritime = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CHL
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_paid }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_awaiting
			COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_clear = yes
			country_exists = PRU
			PRU = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_pending }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.15879 }
		divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_chl_0p05_tt
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		PRU = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.19787 }
			divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_pru_0p05_tt
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_signed
		PRU = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_signed clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_pending }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_paid
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_awaiting

			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_chl
		}
		BOL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_bol }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_bol
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 0.07519 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 8.25729 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_chl
		BOL = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_bol }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHL_dip_execute_france_technical = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CHL
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_paid }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
			COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_clear = yes
			country_exists = FRA
			FRA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.31759 }
		divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_chl_0p1_tt
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		FRA = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.01987 }
			divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 100 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_gdp_setup_fra_0p1_tt
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		CHL = {
			add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_chl category = CAT_industry bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 }
		}
		FRA = {
			add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_fra category = CAT_industry bonus = 0.15 uses = 1 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_signed
		FRA = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_signed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_paid
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
		COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.100 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_offer_france_technical = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_offer_france_technical = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_receipt
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_receipt
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending value = 1 days = 90 }
		FRA = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending value = 1 days = 90 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.8 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_dip_accept_france_technical = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = FRA
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
			CHL = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
				COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_clear = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_paid }
			}
		}
		CHL = { COLDWAR_CHL_dip_execute_france_technical = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				CHL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_signed }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_dip_refuse_france_technical = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = FRA
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
			CHL = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
		CHL = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.101 }
		}
	}
}

		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 8.25729 }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_bol
		BOL = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_bol
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_col
		COL = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_col
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_ecu
		ECU = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_ecu
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_pru
		PRU = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_pru
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_paid
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_awaiting
		COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.104 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHL_dip_accept_andean_protocol_bol = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = BOL
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
			CHL = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_awaiting
				COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_clear = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_bol }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_paid }
			}
		}
		CHL = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_bol
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_col
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_ecu
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_pru
				}
				COLDWAR_CHL_dip_execute_andean_protocol = yes
			}
			else = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.102 }
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_andean_protocol = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_chl
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_bol
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_col
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_ecu
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_pru
			COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_clear = yes
		}
		CHL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_chl }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_chl
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 8.25729 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		BOL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_bol }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_bol
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 0.04512 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		COL = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_col }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_col
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 6.37432 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		ECU = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ecu }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ecu
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 0.01603 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
		PRU = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pru }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pru
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 6.17362 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 52 }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote = 100000 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = COLDWAR_CHL_cost_weekly_quote }
		}
	}
	else = {
		CHL = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_chl }
		BOL = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_bol }
		COL = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_col }
		ECU = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ecu }
		PRU = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pru }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = {
if = {
	limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_usa_mines = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_soviet_machinery = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_japan_copper = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_cuba_clinics = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_argentina_beagle = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_peru_maritime = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_bolivia_transit = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_france_technical = yes
	COLDWAR_CHL_dip_sync_andean_protocol = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_awaiting
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_pending }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_signed }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_awaiting
		USA = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_pending
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL_DIP.103 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_awaiting
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_pending }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_signed }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }

COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_world_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CHL }
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_chl_absent_cleaned
		CHL = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_chl_absent_cleaned }
			}
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_chl_absent_cleaned
			every_country = {
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_weekly = 0 }
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_usa
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_sov
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_jap
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_cuba_clinics_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_cuba_clinics_cub
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_arg
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_pru
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_bol
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_fra
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_chl
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_bol
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_col
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ecu
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pru
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_usa_mines_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_soviet_machinery_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_japan_copper_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_cuba_clinics_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_cuba_clinics_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_argentina_beagle_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_peru_maritime_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_bolivia_transit_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_france_technical_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_awaiting
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_bol
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_col
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_ecu
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_ratified_pru
			}
		}
	}
